Company Description

People create momentum. Technology changes the world. We engineer the intelligence that makes it possible. We're Nagarro, a global AI-native engineering and transformation company. We build products and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. Intelligence isn't something we adopt. It's something we engineer, starting with teams small enough that your ideas move, not wait. That's where you come in!

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to design and evolve data architectures supporting enterprise applications, data integration, and analytics. The ideal candidate combines strong data architecture and modelling expertise with a solid understanding of databases, data integration patterns, and modern data platforms. Cloud experience is an advantage, but architectural expertise and practical design experience are the primary requirements.

Responsibilities  

  • Design end-to-end data architectures covering data ingestion, integration, storage, processing, and consumption.
  • Define conceptual, logical, and physical data models for operational and analytical workloads.
  • Design data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and data marts, selecting appropriate patterns based on business and technical requirements.
  • Define data integration approaches, including ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, APIs, and change data capture (CDC).
  • Establish architecture principles for data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, security, and access control.
  • Assess existing data landscapes and define target architectures, modernization strategies, and migration approaches.
  • Evaluate technology options and architectural trade-offs related to performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and cost.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, solution architects, and engineering teams to translate requirements into implementable designs.
  • Produce architecture documentation, data models, integration specifications, and architecture decisions.
  • Guide engineering teams, review solution designs, and ensure architectural consistency throughout delivery.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, database development, or software engineering, including 3+ years in data architecture or solution design.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise data solutions involving multiple systems, data sources, and consumers.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture principles, including operational versus analytical workloads, data lifecycle, consistency, and historization.
  • Advanced data modeling skills: relational modeling, normalization, dimensional modeling, star schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
  • Strong SQL knowledge and experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle, including database performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing, data lakes, lakehouse architectures, and data marts.
  • Experience designing data pipelines and integration solutions using ETL/ELT, APIs, messaging, and CDC.
  • Knowledge of data governance practices, including data quality, metadata management, lineage, data ownership, and security.
  • Ability to define and document architectural decisions, assess trade-offs, and communicate designs to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience guiding engineering teams and supporting the implementation of architectural solutions.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in English.

Nice to have skills

  • Experience designing data solutions on AWS, using services such as Amazon S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena, Lambda, and Step Functions.
  • Familiarity with AWS data governance and security capabilities, including Lake Formation, IAM, and Glue Data Catalog.
  • Experience with generally applicable technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, dbt, or Airflow.
  • Familiarity with Data Mesh, data products, or data virtualization.
  • Experience with enterprise data migrations, legacy modernization, or hybrid architectures.
  • Experience designing data solutions for AI/ML or advanced analytics.
  • Experience in regulated environments with demanding data security and compliance requirements.

Additional Information

You will work on complex enterprise data initiatives, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and contribute to architectural decisions across diverse technologies and industries.

  • Service Region: Eastern Europe
